QuestInfo.name: Memories of Youth
QuestInfo.0: #p203# of #m10001000# seems to want to deliver good news to #p202#.
QuestInfo.1: #p203# of #m10001000# asked me to deliver the freshly polished #b#t4031117##k to #b#p202##k. She seems a bit cautious about handing it over herself.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered the #t4031117# to #p202# of #m10001000#, and he was extremely surprised yet overjoyed. Seeing his eyes sparkle like that, it looks as though he might set off on an adventure again right this moment! At any rate, I should report all of this back to #p203#.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k

0.0: Thank you so much for finding the weapon he lost so long ago. Since it looked a bit worn out, I polished it up nice and clean. And um... could I ask one more favor of you? I'd like you to deliver this #t4031117# to him in person.

yes.0: Thank you. I thought it would be better for you, the person who actually found it, to hand it over rather than me. Then please deliver this #b#t4031117##k to #p202#. And you must come back and let me know if he was happy about it!

no.0: Hmm... Isn't it a fairly simple favor?

1.0: Aren't you #h0#, who became a resident of our town not long ago? What brings you here today? No way! Could this #t4031117# be...! Isn't this the weapon I lost decades ago! I can't believe it. Where and how in the world did you find this!
1.1: I see... So #p203# did this for me... #p205# was right. In my youth, I was an adventurer whose dream was to travel the whole world. But after facing a life-threatening crisis in a place teeming with ferocious monsters and losing my weapon, I gave up on that dream. But thanks to you, as my old memories return, I even feel like going on an adventure again!

npc.0: I'd like you to deliver this #t4031117# to #p202# yourself. I think it's better for you, who actually found it, to hand it over rather than me.

item.0: Aren't you #h0#, who became a resident of our town not long ago? What brings you here today? You say there's something #p203# asked you to deliver to me? But where is it?

lost.0: Don't tell me you lost the #t4031117# we barely managed to find? Whew... Thank goodness I picked it up... Please, don't lose it this time.
